doc.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
doc.interviewee: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum

title: Credit for bringing out Joe Oliver
summary: She complains George gets no credit for teaching Oliver, who became famous by leaving for Chicago; the band members chipped in to pay Joe.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Yeah, but the judge taught him. He used to be out all over the time. And little, yeah, taught him, little George.
It's hard to think that your husband taught Joe Oliver and also somebody young like...

Yes, somebody young. And lots of time when they've given somebody the credit and I often pass it myself. I say, now, George is dead and George brought Joe Oliver out and they don't say anything about him.
And so many things they did.
See, Joe Oliver or King Oliver as they call him, he made the first really important record.
When he went away from here, you see. He made a name for himself when he left. When he left here.
And he made recordings got all over the world and so they know that name. He didn't know that name. He didn't know that name. He didn't make the record.
He didn't make the record. He didn't go away from... When he did go for that search, he didn't stay long. So that's why did they become world famous like Oliver.
Yeah, like Oliver. How long did Oliver study with him or see around with you? Oh, for a good many years.
I don't know how long long for, until after George died, Oliver left here and went to Chicago.
I mean, did he come for lessons and to study with your father?

With the whole band. With the whole band. He used to teach them. They'd have practice. The whole band, this is the telly, when they got to play me the string orchestra, he taught Joe. They had, used to take him with Joe. All the other older men, they brought Joe in, brought Joe in to play these, with these boys. When he was all playing out of the lake and everything, Joe would go with them. And they'd pay you to make up his salary. Make up his pay, they'd all pitch in and give Joe money. And so, well, Emmanuel didn't tell you that. No, he didn't know. Emmanuel said that. I sure would like to see Emmanuel.
